actual_request.prompt:
Create exactly ONE independently drawn, full-body walking frame of the original mountain guardian boy 04_mountain_guardian_boy. Single character, square canvas, no grid, no montage, no second figure.

REFERENCE ROLES: Reference 1 fixes the original identity and costume. Reference 2 is the verified SOUTHWEST two-pose sheet: its LEFT figure is SW01, the shield-side anatomical LEFT leg low and forward at contact; its RIGHT figure is SW13, the SAME shield-side anatomical LEFT knee raised with the staff-side right boot planted. Reference 3 has the opposite-leg keys: LEFT is SW09 (staff-side leg low forward), RIGHT is SW05 (staff-side knee raised). They are only leg-assignment and camera checks, NOT the requested pose. Reference 4 is existing native single-frame SW12, just BEFORE SW13; use its drawing fidelity, consistent stocky scale, framing and equipment, but do not copy its raised-knee phase. Do NOT reproduce any reference sheet layout or endpoint pose.

DIRECTION AND IDENTITY LOCK: SOUTHWEST front three-quarter camera facing diagonally screen DOWN-LEFT; never front-only, side-only, rear view or mirrored. Huge round head and tiny stocky short body; warm brown/amber eyes, short loose brown fringe, high brown ponytail with pale-green ribbons and gold/jade hair clasp, small gold forehead symbol, wooden bead necklace, ivory and ochre short cloud-trim robe, green braided belt with gold lion-head buckle, puffy short ivory trousers, brown/gold boots and green braided ankle ties. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds the upright gold ring-headed staff on screen LEFT (far side); anatomical LEFT arm holds the green-and-gold round shield on screen RIGHT (near side), with the single gold pauldron on this shield shoulder. Retain original shield relief, staff ring and snake-shaped head detail, jade ring and tassels. Do not exchange hands or add another pauldron.

LEG ASSIGNMENT THROUGH FRAMES 13 -> 14 -> 15 -> 16 -> 01: the SHIELD-SIDE anatomical LEFT leg, whose upper thigh starts on screen RIGHT, is the forward-swinging leg throughout. The STAFF-SIDE anatomical RIGHT leg, whose upper thigh starts on screen LEFT, supports the body until weight transfers at SW01. The near shield-side thigh overlaps the far staff-side thigh naturally; each leg must connect to its own hip. Both boot toes point diagonally DOWN-LEFT, never screen RIGHT. Exactly two opaque legs and exactly two boots, with no ghost, duplicate foot, missing calf or foot fused to the staff.

POSE SW15 — MIDDLE LOWERING AND REACH, exactly halfway from raised SW13 toward SW01 contact. The shield-side LEFT knee has lowered to about halfway between the SW13 raised-knee position and the low SW01 position. Open the short shin farther diagonally DOWN-LEFT so that the moving left boot is distinctly farther forward and lower than SW14, with its heel still clearly airborne at about one third of the SW13 boot-to-floor clearance. Toe points DOWN-LEFT; modestly tip the toe upward relative to the approaching heel without showing a large underside. Staff-side RIGHT foot continues supporting the body near its original ground position; it has not swung forward and has not been exchanged with the moving leg. Keep its forefoot/sole in clear ground contact. No second knee lift.

CONTINUITY AND SCALE: Keep the same head width, face, torso width, short limb proportions, shield/staff scale, fixed camera distance and whole-figure scale as reference 4 and the per-cell scale of references 2/3. Only small natural vertical gait bob, mild cloth fold change and slight ribbon/tassel motion. Do not stretch the thigh/shin to reach the floor, grow the head, shrink the body or reframe the silhouette. Lowest support sole establishes the floor line; staff point and all tassels stay clearly above that line. Keep the whole ponytail, ribbons, body, staff and shield within a clear 5% canvas margin, centered horizontally. Draw genuine new anatomy and cloth motion for this exact phase; do not clone, mirror, interpolate, warp or merely translate a reference pose.

OUTPUT TARGET: Native 2048 x 2048 single-frame square, at least 1024 x 1024 native single-person content canvas. Crisp hand-painted Q-style detail matching the references, bright clean ivory/jade/warm gold and brown, clear soft cloth and metal relief. This is newly drawn native detail, not an enlarged low-resolution sprite. Background genuine transparent RGBA, no floor or shadow. Preserve exact golden snake and bronze-gold circular disk inside the staff head; do not turn a filled disk into an empty ring. Foreground fully solid opaque with clean antialiased edges: no magenta reflection, purple/pink contour halo, magenta holes in boot/cloth, transparency ghosting, duplicate outlines, checkerboard, text, label, border, watermark or effects.
